description: Line absorbers' k-distributions per 1 nm cell reduced from the ExoMol line list TYM for 14N2-16O, version 20240527 (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.g; decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md sections 9-11), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs exomol-k-distributions-merge from the fetched files named here, which are not committed. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE). The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9).
source: ExoMol line list TYM for 14N2-16O, version 20240527 (S. N. Yurchenko, T. M. Mellor and J. Tennyson, ExoMol line lists - LIX. High-temperature line list for N2O, Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. 534 (2024) 1364-1375, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stae2201), its 7 transition files of 13000-20000 cm-1; J. Tennyson et al., The 2024 release of the ExoMol database: molecular line lists for exoplanet and other hot atmospheres, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 326 (2024) 109083, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2024.109083; I. E. Gordon et al., The HITRAN2024 molecular spectroscopic database, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 353 (2026) 109807, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2026.109807 (I. E. Gordon et al., The HITRAN2024 molecular spectroscopic database, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 353 (2026) 109807, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2026.109807; N2O lines 13100-26400 cm-1 (184 lines of 14N2-16O to 14017.06 cm-1; ABG-IMRHT, Huang, Tashkun and Schwenke 2025, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2025.109502))

reduction: N2O merged (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 11, R08.T4.g): below 714 nm every TYM band; from 714 nm HITRAN2024's four bands (1 0 0 6, 6 0 0 3, 2 4 0 4 and 2 0 0 5 from 0 0 0 0, line by line as R08.T4.d) and TYM's bands HITRAN2024 lacks, each band from one list only, TYM's lines of the matched bands binned apart by their states' Herzberg quanta (v1 v2lin l2 v3, upper and lower) and so left out there, those under HITRAN's intensity cut-off with them. TYM's air width 0.07 cm-1/bar (0.0709 cm-1/atm), n 0.5, its default, estimated; the broadening ratios and exponents HITRAN2024's, from its lines alone. Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption at each node from super-lines: every line's S(T) (ExoMol's intensity formula, Q(T) summed from the states file, times HITRAN's natural abundance of the isotopologue) binned linearly on a wavenumber grid of a twelfth of the Doppler half-width at 13100 cm-1, finer than a tenth of the narrowest Voigt half-width; at each node the bins over the cell and 25 cm-1 each side, coarsened by a whole factor while the step stays under a tenth of the node's narrowest Voigt half-width and a 600th of the cut-off (0.042 cm-1), their binning's response divided out, and convolved by FFT with Voigt profiles (Humlicek 1982) cut off 25 cm-1 from each bin at every pressure, at the Doppler widths of the cell's two edges blended linearly in wavenumber; sampled at the cell's points as R08.T4.d's lines are (a quarter of the narrowest Voigt half-width or finer). Every line takes the list's default air width (cm-1 per bar at 296 K, ExoMol's unit), estimated, so that every node's line shape is estimated; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column; temperature nodes 50 K apart, refined to 25 and 12.5 K where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the rows, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3 within its columns (the gated column, and the species' own Rayleigh column, R08.T4.g's ruling); ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md).
